company.name: Active Tribe
company.shortDescription: Active Tribe develops digital tools and platforms focused on fitness, wellness, and active lifestyle engagement.
company.description: Active Tribe is a technology company focused on digital solutions for fitness, wellness, and active lifestyle communities. The company develops platforms and tools that support engagement between individuals, fitness professionals, sports organizations, and wellness-focused businesses. Its services are designed to help users manage activities, participate in fitness programs, and connect with health and recreation initiatives through digital experiences.
